More than a prescription

A doctor’s assessment. A clear care plan.

Every visit includes seven days of follow-up messaging to support its recommendations.

Physician-led decisions

Your history and goals guide the plan. Medication is prescribed only when clinically appropriate.

Your care plan, explained

Ask questions about the recommendations from your visit. New concerns or additional treatments require a separate visit.

Seven days of follow-up

Messaging support for the assessment and care plan from your visit—not a new assessment for unrelated concerns.
